facts.text: Andrew had a picnic with his girlfriend on the previous Friday, which he described as amazing and refreshing.

evidence.quote: Last Friday was amazing - I had a picnic with my girlfriend and it was so much fun! Being in the nature can be so refreshing and it always brings me joy.

facts.text: Audrey mentioned that she had a great walk with her furry friends and that being in nature is nice.

evidence.quote: Wow sounds like the picnic was awesome! Yeah being in the nature is so nice. My furry friends always make me happy. We had a great walk the other day - felt really good!

facts.text: Andrew expressed a desire to get a dog but mentioned the difficulty of finding a suitable place for a dog to live.

evidence.quote: I wish I could get one, but like I said, it's tough to find a place and find the right dog.

facts.text: Audrey explained that she found a breeder nearby that had the dogs she wanted, but noted that places allowing dogs are hard to find.

evidence.quote: I got lucky finding a breeder nearby that has the dogs I wanted. Yeah places that allows dogs are really hard to find unfortunately.
